concern_results.conclusion: The gate change (per-(concern,skill) uniqueness) still enforces full required-concern coverage and derived-owner declaration; the table firing-path lambda requires base-absence, added-line membership, file-unique anchor, owner scope, and a real header+delimiter table, so it widens the accept set only as documented.

No write-path, auth, tenant or actor bypass in the diff. The one destructive act — unlinking a saved sample before rerunning it — is reached only after quota admission on a run that will actually start, and the cache-resume/report-only paths are asserted to leave prior samples byte-identical. requirement-scope's relaxed appetite rule still forbids agent-side scope cuts, acceptance downgrades and fabricated human fallback.

The evaluator's BaseException path kills the recorded process group, bounds drain/reap to 1s each, records cleanup_unconfirmed, re-raises the original non-timeout exception unchanged, and closes both streams in finally. Cleanup uncertainty aborts further samples and judges rather than banking results. eval-golden-trace now fails closed on malformed, missing, duplicated or non-success terminal events.

Tests would fail with the risky behavior present: the 15 table cases assert the specific diagnostic (impact_chain_firing_path_missing / impact_chain_behavior_evidence_missing) rather than bare nonzero, the standalone gate-run counter moved 97→112 so silently skipped fixtures fail, and the gate's invalid-plan controls assert rc=2 plus absence of state/client_sequence (no provider execution).

Changes are additive to existing accept paths (normative list rules and executables remain); the removed global concern-dedup is replaced by a stricter-per-owner rule with an explicit implicit-vs-explicit default-owner duplicate control. No abstraction added without a current test.

No migration or irreversible artifact in this partition; committed base.txt pins the comparison base for the frozen candidate. Publication/packaging is out of this partition and is not claimed as done in the diff.

Failure states are surfaced: cleanup_unconfirmed strings propagate into run-log, verdict statuses, an explicit ABORT message and exit 1; the report is marked INCOMPLETE. Doc copy for alerting/authority now states diagnosis and ownership requirements rather than implying automatic remedies.

The shared impact-chain gate remains the high-risk surface. The table path does not bypass owner scoping, round scoping, anchor uniqueness or the RED-baseline package floor, and the register/controls text explicitly states the check proves location and shape, not factual accuracy or an executed model trial — no copy implies unavailable verification.
